name: Platform Metadata Consistency Hotfix
summary: Makes the central Subsystem Registry complete and visible, standardizes official subsystem names, and adds automated checks for registry, manifest and UI consistency.
changes: Platform Intelligence now renders every registered versioned subsystem, including Subsystem Registry, Audit Engine, Platform Contracts, Casa Amar Core and Public Website Runtime.
Standardized the official name Governance Service and retained Project Brain, Diagnostics Framework and Configuration Service as canonical names.
Added manifest coverage validation so every versioned subsystem must exist in the central registry.
Added UI inventory regression validation so every registered subsystem must be visible in Platform Intelligence.
Removed the manually maintained subsystem display list from Mission Control.
